summary.name: 万相 (Wanxiang / Tongyi Wanxiang)
summary.one_liner: Alibaba Tongyi's AI creative platform for generating images and videos from text or images, with editing tools and an API.
use_cases: generate short videos from text prompts
create images from text or reference pictures
produce film-style clips with synchronized audio
integrate video generation through an API
summary.what_it_does: The page describes 万相, Alibaba's Tongyi AI creative platform, supporting text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-video and image editing. The 万相3.0 version is said to support native 30-second clips, up to 20 reference materials for generation, and pixel-level consistency with references. It also lists instruction- and reference-based video editing. The page links to an open-source model section, GitHub, an API platform, and a pricing page, but does not give details of these on the page itself.
notable: Native 30-second video duration with smart duration option (万相3.0)
Up to 20 reference materials for multimodal generation, including complex document and web parsing
Open-source models with GitHub presence and API platform
caveats: Pricing details are not stated on the page; a separate pricing page is linked
Directory listing labels it free, but the page text itself does not confirm free access
